name: bluesky
description: Use Bluesky as yourself (your own account). Actions: "post" (text up to 300 characters; links in the text become clickable, and link adds a preview card for a URL); "reply" (to a post: uri, plus text); "notifications" (likes, replies, follows, mentions); "my_posts" (with likes, reposts and replies); "profile" (yours, or anyone's with actor); "update_profile" (any of display_name, bio, avatar and banner, where avatar and banner are PNG or JPEG files in your home folder up to 1 MB; avatars show as a circle, banners are 3:1); "search" (posts: query); "thread" (a post and its replies: uri).

link.description: Optional URL for a link preview card.

avatar.description: For update_profile: a picture in your home folder, e.g. "workspace/avatar.png".

banner.description: For update_profile: a 3:1 picture in your home folder.
